product_overview: PixL Backend is a Spring Boot REST API for the PixL DOOH advertising platform. It supports user authentication, admin management of campaigns/media/playlists, and device pairing plus synchronization for Android TV and tablet players.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication and user profile access
Enable admins to create, list, and delete advertising campaigns
Support upload, listing, and organization of media assets and playlists
Allow screen devices to pair, heartbeat, and fetch synchronized campaign content
Record proof-of-play activity and deliver notifications to users

features.name: Authentication & Security
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, and retrieve their authenticated profile using JWT-based security.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid user details -> Receive 201/200 confirming account creation -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with authentication error
POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 400/409 conflict indicating the account cannot be created

features.name: User Profile API
features.description: Lets authenticated users fetch and update their profile and settings.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/user/me with token -> Receive 200 with current user profile details
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/user/profile with updated fields -> Receive 200 confirming profile update
GET /api/user/me without a valid JWT token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
PUT /api/user/profile with invalid or null profile fields -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors

features.name: Campaign Management API
features.description: Provides admin capabilities to list, create, and delete advertising campaigns, including single-screen and multiscreen grid layouts.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/admin/campaigns with token -> Receive 200 with campaign list
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/admin/campaigns with valid campaign payload -> Receive 201/200 with created campaign details
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /api/admin/campaigns/{id} with existing campaign ID -> Receive 200/204 confirming deletion
POST /api/auth/login with non-admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/admin/campaigns with token -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /api/admin/campaigns/{id} with missing/invalid campaign ID -> Receive 404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request

features.name: TV Screen Synchronization API
features.description: Handles public device pairing, content synchronization, heartbeat pings, and proof-of-play reporting for screen players.
user_flows: POST /api/tv/pair with valid 6-digit pairing code -> Receive 200 with screen ID and device JWT token -> GET /api/tv/sync -> Receive 200 with active campaign, layout mode, zones, and media URLs
POST /api/tv/pair with invalid or expired pairing code -> Receive 400/401 with pairing error
GET /api/tv/sync without a paired device context -> Receive 404 or 200 with no active campaign content depending on current state
POST /api/tv/ping with device identifier/token -> Receive 200 and update last_ping_at plus online status
POST /api/tv/proof-of-play with play impression payload -> Receive 200 confirming impression logged
POST /api/tv/pair with a code already used or expired -> Receive 409 Conflict or 400 Bad Request

features.name: Media Management API
features.description: Allows authenticated admins to list media assets and upload new files to DigitalOcean Spaces or S3.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/admin/media with token -> Receive 200 with media file list
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/admin/media/upload with valid image/video file -> Receive 201/200 with uploaded media metadata and storage URL
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/admin/media/upload with unsupported file type or oversized file -> Receive 400 Bad Request
GET /api/admin/media without a valid JWT token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Playlist Management API
features.description: Lets authenticated admins list and create playlists that reference uploaded media items.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/admin/playlists with token -> Receive 200 with playlist list
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/admin/playlists with valid playlist name and media references -> Receive 201/200 with playlist details
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/admin/playlists with missing media references or invalid payload -> Receive 400 Bad Request
GET /api/admin/playlists without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Notification API
features.description: Provides authenticated users access to system notifications and lets them mark notifications as read.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/notifications with token -> Receive 200 with notification list
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read with a valid notification ID -> Receive 200 confirming notification marked as read
PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read with a non-existent notification ID -> Receive 404 Not Found
GET /api/notifications without a valid JWT token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
